05/Dated: 22 March, 2023
1.

Learned counsel for the applicant is directed to add the informant as O.P. No.02, in course of the
day.
2. Issue notice to the newly added O.P. No.02, under the registered cover with A/D as well as under ordinary process.

3. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.
4.

The applicant-husband, who is in custody since 28.09.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Patherdih P.S. Case No.28 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 417/ 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code.
5. It appears that both the parties are major and they have got marriage.
The applicant-husband is not accepting the factum of marriage although the marriage has been consummated.
6. Considering the above facts, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on provisional bail for a period of six months from the date of release.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on Amit Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand ...... Opp. Party on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169504046/
